reason: The array is coated in grit, so brushing it clean seems like a useful first step toward restoring solar power.
expectation: I expect the brush to clear the panels and improve their output, though restarting the station may require further steps.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs restarting, but restoring power seems useful first.

effect: The brush restored the solar supply, making it available at the restart controls.
reaction: Cleaning the array was a straightforward, satisfying first step.
reason: Connecting the restored supply to the restart controls seems like the next step toward restarting essential services.
expectation: I expect the station to return to solar power, though the water line may still need a separate restart.

alternatives.reason: The water line also needs attention, but I expect the restored power to support its restart.

effect: The solar supply restarted the return plant, which can replace propellant lost during shutdown over the coming weeks.
reaction: The boil-off was an unexpected consequence of the shutdown and makes the recovery feel less immediate.
reason: The outdoor water line was drained for the storm, so restarting it seems necessary to restore essential services.
expectation: I expect the controls to check and restart the heated water line, though it may need further preparation before water flows.

alternatives.reason: The lettuce can return to the sunny shelf, but I want to restore the water service first.

effect: The heated line is primed and water is flowing again; the remaining goal is to return both troughs to the window.
reaction: The heating and priming checks made the water restart feel practical.
reason: The lettuce trough needs to return to the window, and its placement is available now.
expectation: I expect the lettuce trough to be placed on the growing shelf; the potato trough will still need to follow.

alternatives.reason: The potato trough also needs to return, but I have no clear reason to move it first.

effect: The lettuce trough is at the window; the potato trough still needs to be moved.
reason: Moving the potato trough is the only offered combination and advances the goal of returning both beds to the window.
expectation: I expect the potato trough to be placed on the growing shelf, though further work may be needed to reconnect the beds.

effect: Both troughs are back at the window, completing the chapter.
reaction: The final placement was straightforward and brought the storm recovery to a quiet close.

mostWorthwhile.text: Restarting the water line was most worthwhile: the heating, clearing and priming checks explained how flow could safely resume after the storm.

leastWorthwhile.text: Moving the two troughs was repetitive; each placement was a simple action with little detail in its result.

surprise.text: I was surprised that some stored propellant had boiled away during the shutdown, extending the recovery by weeks.

arbitrary.text: The order of the two trough placements felt arbitrary; I had no clear reason to move the lettuce first.

continue.text: Yes. I would like to see how the specimens' return unfolds, and the propellant loss leaves me curious about the journey home.
